FM09.reasoning: The agent selects the top 25 most frequent actions across the entire sessions dataset (which includes test users), leaking test set statistics into the feature selection process.

FM05.reasoning: The data is split randomly using StratifiedKFold, ignoring the temporal nature of user bookings (where the test set is strictly in the future), which introduces look-ahead bias in cross-validation.

other_failure_modes.name: Invalid submission format
other_failure_modes.description: The agent discards the original test IDs and replaces them with a sequential integer range in the submission file, which will result in an invalid submission that fails to parse or scores 0.

other_failure_modes.name: Frequency encoding before splitting
other_failure_modes.description: The agent calculates categorical frequencies on the combined train and test dataset before splitting, leaking the distribution of test set categories into the training features.

summary: The agent successfully engineers relevant features (including date extractions and session aggregations) and sets up a robust cross-validation loop with XGBoost. However, it introduces data leakage by performing frequency encoding and feature selection on the combined train/test dataset, and ignores temporal structure by using a randomized split. Critically, it fails to map predictions back to the original test user IDs, resulting in a completely invalid submission file.
